title: みんなの人気者の後に・目指すは……

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara and I decide to watch the Arima Kinen… a very high-profile race in which the participants are all popular and top-class Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her heart pounds as she watches Special Week and Grass Wonder push themselves to their absolute limits in this fierce competition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She realizes she wants to race in such an exciting place too and loudly declares that she plans to enter the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing those words, the audience members around her begin to murmur about how absurd that sounds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, Haru Urara is not to be swayed. She begins her long and arduous path toward entering the Arima Kinen!
